title: 第十七章 洗凡七大境第十八章 升月

read2（）;林无缺目光平静的平视前方，对于突然从身后响起的声音充耳不闻。这十年来，他在慕容家所经历过的嘲讽、奚落远远是他人所难以想象的。
从这个叫做司马傲的嘴中响起来的带着蔑视的质疑声，根本无法让林无缺的内心产生丝毫的波动，或者说，因为这十年的经历，林无缺对这一切早已看淡了，除非他想，否则，同辈之中已经很难有人可以用言语将他激怒。
林璎珞眼中划过一丝了然，林无缺的反应不在她的意料之外，在见识过前天发生在慕容家的战斗，见识到林无缺约战君山烈那个可怕无比的同龄人后，林璎珞就知道，林无缺已经走上了一条常人想都不敢想的路。
司马傲在年轻一代中或许算的上优秀，但比之君山烈，实在是差的太远太远。
站在林无缺身后的司马傲发觉自己说出的话竟然遭到了眼前这个连魄月都没有凝聚的家伙的无视，向来信奉实力就是规矩的他心中隐泛怒意，不过瞥了瞥自己钟情的林璎珞，似乎不愿在她面前失态，司马傲暂时压下了心中的怒意。
齐世龙负手而立，武袍迎风猎猎，御空而行，但对身后三个小家伙的一举一动洞若观火。
他知道，林无缺的突然出现，定然会引起司马傲的不满，而林璎珞，齐世龙却不担心，这个小妮子比任何人都善于观察。
在接下来的一个月内，齐世龙将会动用手中所有的资源，尽全力培养这三个年轻人，争取让他们在百城大战来临之前，实力能获得一定的提升。
尤其是林无缺，齐世龙对于此子的期望最大，锻体大圆满就能越阶而战击败洗凡英魄境的慕容天，此子积累之浑厚远远超出同阶，若是他能在这一个月中凝聚魄月踏入洗凡境，那么，他就会成为这一次三人当中的王牌！
“看来、这一次的百城大战我也要争一争了，赵无极，此番，就来彻底分个高下吧。”
齐世龙略带沧桑的眸子当中闪过一丝不为人知的锋芒。
“嗖”
元力光圈划过天际，林无缺细细端详半响，突然出声打破了寂静：“齐城主，小子如今已是锻体大圆满，对于如何凝聚魄月，踏入洗凡境还尚有不小的疑惑，敢请齐城主解惑。”
抱臂而立的司马傲听到林无缺如此发问，目光中一抹轻蔑之意不加掩饰。
“呵呵，好，此距离我的府邸还需要一段距离，本城主就为你来说说这魄月，林璎珞，司马傲，你二人虽然都已经凝聚魄月踏入洗凡境，但接下来的内容，对你们而言也有着一定的作用。”
齐世龙的话回响在林璎珞和司马傲的耳中，前者轻轻点头，后者目光当中也涌上一抹认真。
“修士修炼，首先第一个阶段便是锻体境，顾名思义，便是将己身的皮、肉、筋、骨、髓悉数炼透，打熬肉身，凝练气血，浩浩荡荡，与体内的元力水乳交融，最终浑身上下，里里外外合为一体，达致大圆满境界，也就是林无缺你现在所处的境界。那么接下来就是如何突破洗凡境。”
“提到洗凡境，就不得不提洗凡境的标志，魄月！何谓魄月？它又是如何产生的？人，乃万物之灵，人一出生，便有七魄伴随，七魄分为：英魄，精魄，力魄，源魄，气魄，灵慧魄，天冲魄。只是普通人一生也不能得见自己的七魄，因为它无形无质。”
“只有境界到达锻体大圆满的修士才可以感觉到这七魄的存在，而在感觉到七魄的存在之后，修士便要将这无形无质的七魄一一凝聚出来，七魄当中蕴含着强大的力量，这也是魄月存在的原因，魄月就是七魄的具化显现。七魄对应洗凡七大境，而魄月则随着七魄的不断凝聚，也会不断的变化颜色。”

说到这里，齐世龙发觉身后的三个年轻人都在聚精会神的听着，露出满意的笑容，齐世龙接着开口：“洗凡第一境英魄境和第二境精魄境分别对于淡银和深银色，第三境力魄境和第四境源魄境分别对应淡紫色和深紫色，而最后三境气魄境、灵慧境和天冲境则对应着紫金、淡金、黄金三色。所以，换句话说，通过辨认对方修士的魄月颜色，也可以确定对方的修为是处于洗凡境的哪一个境界。比如林璎珞、司马傲，你二人如今都是淡银色魄月，并开始有向着深银色转化的趋势，证明着你二人如今的修为是在洗凡英魄境的巅峰。”
“嗡”
随着齐世龙的话语，林璎珞和司马傲浑身一震，身后升起一轮淡银色魄月，浮浮沉沉，散发出强大的波动。
“所以，你二人在接下来的一个月中应当全力冲击精魄境初期，如果能成功，你二人的元力将会提升许多。毕竟，在洗凡七大境中，每一个境界之间，如果没有强大的战斗绝学帮助，将会鸿沟分明，因为比你们高一个境界的修士单纯凭借浑厚的元力可以轻易的耗死你。而林无缺，我给你半个月的时间，你必须凝聚魄月，踏入洗凡英魄境，唯有这样，在百城大战，你才有资格有能力去得到自己想要的。”
最后一句话让林无缺心中一动，随即璀璨的目光中锐意十足。
是啊！
百城大战可不是随随便便什么人都能参加的，每一个参加的修士，都是代表着自己所在的主城，个个都是年轻天才，就拿身边的这二人来讲，随便一人，都可以轻易击败慕容天。
若是想要在百城大战中获得耀眼的成绩，那么必然需要着强大的实力。林无缺明白，自己凭借着斗战圣法本源可以越阶而战，锻体大圆满可战洗凡英魄境。但这样的战力，在百城大战中，根本算不了什么，林无缺可以想象，在那百城大战中出战的天才中，修为达到第二境精魄境初期的或许大有人在，甚至有一些天才已经达到了精魄境中期，或许连那精魄境后期的高手都会出现。
现在的他，还是太过于弱小，凝聚魄月，踏入洗凡英魄境，对于林无缺来说，迫在眉睫！
一旦成功突破洗凡英魄境，林无缺隐隐感觉自己的战力将会有一个巨大的飞跃，因为林无缺从丹田内的斗战圣法本源上感受到一股令他自己都感觉到心悸的气息。
况且，在突破至洗凡境后，除却斗战圣法本源，林无缺还有一个底牌，那就是福伯留给他的血龙玉。
慕容天之所以与他对决，就是为了这枚血龙玉，因为福伯在留下血龙玉之时，说过，洗凡境的修士凭借此玉将会获得一次意想不到的造化！

read2(); Lin Wuque looked straight ahead calmly, turning a deaf ear to the sudden sound from behind. In the past ten years, the ridicule and ridicule he had experienced in the Murong family were far beyond what others could imagine.
The disdainful questioning sound coming from the mouth of this man named Sima Ao could not make Lin Wuque's heart fluctuate at all. In other words, because of his ten years of experience, Lin Wuque had already taken everything lightly. Unless he wanted to, it would be difficult for anyone among his peers to anger him with words.
A flash of understanding flashed in Lin Yingluo's eyes, and Lin Wuque's reaction was not unexpected. After witnessing the battle at Murong's house the day before yesterday, and seeing Lin Wuque's appointment with Jun Shanlie, a terrifying peer of his own age, Lin Yingluo knew that Lin Wuque had embarked on a path that ordinary people would never dare to imagine.
Sima Ao may be considered outstanding among the younger generation, but compared to Jun Shanlie, he is really far behind.
Sima Ao, who was standing behind Lin Wuque, found that what he said was ignored by the guy in front of him who couldn't even condense the Soul Moon. He always believed that strength was the rule, and there was a hint of anger in his heart. However, he glanced at Lin Yingluo, whom he loved, and seemed unwilling to lose his composure in front of her. Sima Ao temporarily suppressed the anger in his heart.
Qi Shilong stood with his hands behind his back, hunting in the wind with his martial robe, and walked in the air, but he was very aware of every move of the three little guys behind him.
He knew that Lin Wuque's sudden appearance would definitely arouse Sima Ao's dissatisfaction, but Lin Yingluo and Qi Shilong were not worried. This little girl was better at observing than anyone else.
In the next month, Qi Shilong will use all the resources at his disposal to train these three young people and strive to improve their strength before the Hundred Cities War.
Especially Lin Wuque, Qi Shilong has the highest expectations for this son. After completing the body training, he can cross the level and defeat Murong Tian in the Xifan Heroic Soul Realm. This son's accumulation is far beyond the same level. If he can condense the Soul Moon in this month and step into the Ximort Realm, then he will become the ace among the three this time!
"It seems that I will also compete in the Hundred Cities Battle this time. Zhao Wuji, this time, let's compete completely."
An unknown edge flashed through Qi Shilong's slightly aged eyes.
"Whoosh"
The aperture of Yuanli flashed across the sky. Lin Wuque studied it carefully for a while, and suddenly broke the silence with a voice: "City Lord Qi, the boy has now reached the Great Perfection of Physical Training. He still has a lot of doubts about how to condense the Soul Moon and step into the Cleansing Mortal Realm. I dare to ask City Lord Qi to clarify his doubts."
Sima Ao, who was standing with his arms folded, heard Lin Wuque's question with an undisguised look of contempt in his eyes.
"Haha, okay, this is still some distance from my mansion. I, the city lord, will tell you about the Soul Moon. Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao, although you two have already condensed the Soul Moon and stepped into the Cleansing Mortal Realm, the following content will also have a certain effect on you."
Qi Shilong's words echoed in the ears of Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao. The former nodded slightly, and the latter also had a look of seriousness in his eyes.
"The first stage of a monk's training is the physical training state. As the name suggests, it is to refine all the skin, flesh, tendons, bones, and marrow of the body, to beat the body, condense the energy and blood, and blend with the vitality in the body. Finally, the whole body, inside and outside, become one, reaching the state of great perfection, which is the state you are in now, Lin Wuque. Then the next step is how to break through the realm of cleansing."
"When it comes to the Cleansing Mortal Realm, we have to mention the symbol of the Cleansing Mortal Realm, the Soul Moon! What is the Soul Moon? How is it produced? Human beings are the spirits of all things. As soon as a person is born, he is accompanied by seven souls. The seven souls are divided into: Ying Soul, Jing Soul, Li Soul, Source Soul, Vigor, Linghui Soul, and Tianchong Soul. But ordinary people cannot see their own seven souls in their lifetime, because they are intangible and without quality."
"Only monks who have reached the Great Perfection of Forging the Body can feel the existence of these seven souls. After feeling the existence of the seven souls, the monks must condense the invisible and qualityless seven souls one by one. The seven souls contain powerful power. This is also the reason why the soul moon exists. The soul moon is the embodiment of the seven souls. The seven souls correspond to the seven realms of purifying the mortal world, and the soul moon will continue to change color as the seven souls continue to condense. "
At this point, Qi Shilong realized that the three young people behind him were listening attentively and showed a satisfied smile. Qi Shilong then spoke: "The first level of Xifan's Heroic Soul Realm and the second Jingso Realm correspond to light silver and dark silver respectively. The third level of Lipo Realm and the fourth Realm of Yuanpo Realm correspond to lavender and dark purple respectively. The last three levels of Qibo Realm, Linghui Realm and Tianchong Realm correspond to the three colors of purple gold, light gold and gold. So, in other words, by identifying the color of the soul moon of the other monk, you can also determine which state of the Cleansing Mortal Realm the other monk is in. For example, Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao, both of you are now light silver Soul Moon, and have begun to transform into dark silver, which proves that your current cultivation is at the peak of the Pure Mortal Heroic Soul Realm. "
"Buzz"
Following Qi Shilong's words, Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao were shocked, and a pale silver soul moon rose behind them, floating and sinking, emitting powerful fluctuations.
"So, you two should go all out to attack the early stage of the Jingjing Realm in the next month. If you can succeed, your Yuanli will be greatly improved. After all, among the seven realms of Xifan, if there is no help from powerful combat skills, there will be a huge gap between each realm, because monks at a higher realm than you can easily consume you to death simply by relying on their strong Yuan Power. As for Lin Wuque, I will give you half a month. You must gather the soul moon and step into the realm of the heroic spirit. Only in this way can you be qualified and capable to get what you want in the Hundred Cities Battle. "
The last sentence made Lin Wuque's heart move, and then his bright eyes were full of determination.
Yes!
Not just anyone can participate in the Hundred Cities War. Every monk who participates represents the main city where they are located. They are all young geniuses. Take the two people around them, any one of them can easily defeat Murong Tian.
If you want to achieve dazzling results in the Hundred Cities War, you must have strong strength. Lin Wuque understood that he could fight across levels by relying on the Holy Law of Fighting, and that the Great Perfection of Body Training could fight against the Pure Mortal Heroic Soul Realm. But this kind of combat power is nothing in the Hundred Cities War. Lin Wuque can imagine that among the geniuses who fought in the Hundred Cities War, there may be many who have reached the early stage of the second Jingso Realm. There are even some geniuses who have reached the middle Jingso Realm. Perhaps even the masters of the late Jingso Realm will appear.
He is still too weak now. It is imminent for Lin Wuque to gather the soul moon and step into the realm of purifying the heroic soul!
Once he successfully broke through to the Pure Mortal Heroic Soul Realm, Lin Wuque vaguely felt that his combat power would take a huge leap, because Lin Wuque felt an aura from the source of the holy fighting magic in his dantian that made him feel palpitations.
Moreover, after breaking through to the Mortal Cleansing Realm, apart from the origin of the Holy Law of Dou Zhan, Lin Wuque also had a trump card, which was the Blood Dragon Jade left to him by Uncle Fu.
The reason why Murong Tian fought against him was because of the Blood Dragon Jade, because when Uncle Fu left the Blood Dragon Jade, he said that monks in the Mortal Cleansing Realm would receive an unexpected blessing with this jade!
